id: title:VojtechBartos:keep tagged replies out of the untagged followup path

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a bot-tagging gate and conditional routing to the Slack app workflow, preventing untagged-followup classification when the bot is explicitly addressed.
review.reason: Adds a bot-tagging gate and conditional routing to the Slack app workflow, preventing untagged-followup classification when the bot is explicitly addressed.
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the helper function and the complete workflow setup, so the full behavior and failure handling cannot be verified; the score relies on the presence of the gate and routing checks rather than end-to-end execution.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the helper function `_every_mention_is_a_path_segment` referenced in P1.F1.H1, nor the definition of `ROUTE_HANDLED_LOCALLY` or the `_start_mention_workflow` mock setup. Without these dependencies, the complete behavior and failure handling cannot be verified. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new gate function `_message_tags_bot` to detect if a Slack message explicitly mentions the app's bot user, while also checking if mentions are path segments.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the Slack thread-reply message copy from entering the untagged-followup pipeline, avoiding false-positive prompts when the bot is explicitly addressed.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check using the new gate before allowing an event to proceed to the untagged-followup workflow, and returns a locally handled route if the bot is tagged.
observations.posthog_connection: This blocks the untagged-followup classifier and prompt from running on messages that explicitly address the app, while still allowing the mention-only workflow to handle them.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameterized test case asserting that when a bot user ID is resolved and the message tags the bot, the untagged-followup workflow is skipped; also tests unresolvable bot ID and path-segment mentions.
observations.posthog_connection: This validates the routing decision and the expected behavior of the workflow start, including the untagged-followup flag, under various tagging and bot-ID scenarios.
